text: The Garworth warehouse's reorder threshold is 2,450. Esme asked whether the print room is free in the evening. Finn needs notes from the evening meeting. Opal needs notes from the afternoon meeting. Hugo asked whether the library annex is free in the afternoon. Previously: The Garnick warehouse's reorder threshold is 4,700. Mira wants the harbour room kept clear for visitors, while Hugo wants the north office kept clear for visitors. The morning stand-up has been moved to the garden studio. Bram and Finn are swapping desks this week. Someone left an umbrella in the library annex again. The coffee machine in the east wing is working again. The print room is being repainted, so expect some noise in the morning and evening. Esme thinks the north office is too cold in the afternoon. The loading bay is being repainted, so expect some noise in the afternoon. Vik thinks the north office is too cold in the morning. New shelving in the print room has been fitted and inspected. Heating in the yard office will be repaired before the end of the month. Two of the storage racks need new labels. The cleaning rota for the upper landing has changed.
